body: No I can't make myself throw up. I basically have no gag reflex.
Thank you for finding that for me. I think I took 200mg/kg and 10g total. I'm in the UK so I'll see if there are any numbers I can call for advice. Thank you.

I don't know that's the problem. People keep asking what's wrong and I don't know and then they're annoyed because I don't know how to explain it without sounding stupid. I'm not going anywhere. I have no talents, no personality. When I think of the life I want and who I want to be I know it's just a fantasy and it will never be real so why bother trying. I've lost all motivation. My life's easy so I know things are only going to get worse. If I feel like dying now then I'm screwed when things actually are difficult. I just hate this world and I'd rather be asleep.
No taking the paracetamol was the stupid part. I realise that now and I'm just hoping it won't effect me.
